name: D04_1_one_counter_per_gain_no_double_strike_below_25
notes: Printed: 'Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' and 'As long as you have 25 or more life, this creature has double strike.' Seat 0's lifelinker deals 3 damage: one life gain (20 -> 23) is one counter, not three: the 3/3 Paladin is a 4/4. 23 is below 25: no double strike.
